name: Air Jordan 6 Retro 'UNC Home'
story_html: The Air Jordan 6 Retro ‘UNC Home’ features a familiar color combination that pays homage to MJ’s alma mater. The iconic silhouette carries a white leather upper with nubuck underlays in University Blue. Contrasting navy accents make their way to the molded TPU heel tab, textile collar lining and polyurethane midsole, the latter enhanced with visible Air-sole cushioning. Reflective perforations provide added visibility in low-light conditions, while a woven jock tag at the heel nods to the shoe’s varsity athletics theme.
